name: underdocks_moves
source: slaythespire.wiki.gg Slay_the_Spire_2 pages, checked 2026-11-01. Wiki numbers, NOT decompiled values; PR-014 parity must re-verify every entry against the local 0.111 sts2.dll.

mechanics.Ravenous: Corpse Slug eats dead allies -> Stunned + Strength (v0: not implemented, documented)
mechanics.Thorns: reflects attack damage back at the attacker (Toadpole Spiken)
mechanics.Ritual: gains its stacks as Strength at the end of each of its turns (Cultists)
mechanics.Smoggy: the player may play at most 1 Skill per turn (Living Fog)
mechanics.Suck: unblocked attack damage it deals becomes Strength (Fossil Stalker)
mechanics.Plating: gains X Block at end of its turn, loses 1 at start of its turn (Sewer Clam, Lagavulin)
mechanics.Thievery: steals gold on attack (Gremlin Merc; v0 logs only, no gold economy)
mechanics.HardenedShell: cannot lose more than X HP per turn (Skulking Colony)
mechanics.Skittish: the first time it is hit each turn, gains X Block (Phantasmal Gardener)
mechanics.Slow: receives 10% more damage from Attacks per card played this turn (Bygone Effigy)
mechanics.SteamEruption: stored damage explodes on death (Waterfall Giant; invulnerable phase not modeled in v0)
mechanics.Vigor: next attack +X damage, consumed (Terror Eel Thrash)
mechanics.Intangible: all damage and HP loss reduced to 1 (Soul Fysh Fade)
mechanics.Asleep: sleeps X turns or until damaged; loses all Plating on wake (Lagavulin Matriarch)
mechanics.Territorial: gains its stacks as Strength at end of its turns (Byrdonis)
mechanics.Plow: HP threshold stun (Ceremonial Beast; edge case simplified when already below threshold)

status_cards.Dazed: unplayable, Ethereal (exhausts from hand at end of turn)
status_cards.Infection: unplayable, 'At end of your turn in hand: take 3 damage'
status_cards.Beckon: unplayable, 'At end of your turn in hand: lose 6 HP'

not_implemented: Ruby Raiders random composition (v0 fixes 3 of 5, but the 5 raiders are implemented)
Gremlin Merc's death summon (Fat + Sneaky Gremlin)
